entities.summary: Lev Aleksandrovich Kulidzhanov was a Soviet and Armenian film director, screenwriter and professor at the Gerasimov Institute of Cinematography. He was the head of the Union of Cinematographers of the USSR (1965–1986). People's Artist of the USSR (1976). He directed a total of twelve films between 1955 and 1994.
